Blicky Special Magical Unbelievable Maga.Description:
A Special Magical Unbelievable Magazine for toy gun named Blicky. It can store rounds of calibers: 
- 12.7x108mm (Anti-materiel Rifle)
- 7.62x54r (Light Machine Gun)
- 40x46mm grenades (Rifle Grenade Launcher)
- 7.62x25TT (World War II) 
- 5.56x45 NATO (Assault Rifle)
